formatVersion.description: Schema version for this comparison format.

comparisonMode.description: The mode of comparison being performed.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this comparison.

sources.description: The source documents being compared. At least two sources are required.

matching.description: Configuration for how requirements were matched across sources.

summary.description: Summary statistics for the overall comparison.

requirementDiffs.description: Detailed comparison of individual requirements between sources.

componentDiffs.description: Comparison of components between two system documents. Used in systemDrift mode.

packageDiffs.description: Comparison of packages between two SBOMs. Used in systemDrift mode for SBOM comparison.

systemRef.description: URI identifying the system being compared in systemDrift mode.

drift.description: External/metadata changes separate from status changes (Terraform pattern).

annotations.description: Map of annotation IDs to annotation objects, providing context or action items for requirement diffs.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this comparison document.

extensions.description: Reserved for tool-specific data not defined in the HDF standard.

description: Structured comparison between two or more HDF security assessment documents. Supports temporal, baseline, fleet, and multi-source comparison modes.
title: HDF Comparison
